meaning: Unique respondent identifier assigned by the survey vendor
coding_units: No unit; one row per respondent
role: Record key; not used in models

meaning: Final survey weight for the population of U.S. adults aged 18+ with a bank or credit union account
role: Weighted descriptive statistics; weighted sensitivity models

meaning: Times in the past year the respondent experienced fraud or scams involving the primary checking, savings or money market account (not a credit card)
coding_units: Count band: Never; One time; Two or three times; More than three times; I'm not sure
role: Source of FRAUD_EXP (RQ1, RQ4) and REPEAT_VICTIM (RQ2)

meaning: Whether money was lost to the most recent fraud or scam (asked only if FRAUD1 is one time or more)
coding_units: Lost, all recovered; Lost, some recovered; Lost, none recovered; No money taken; I don't know

meaning: Times in the past year the bank placed a fraud alert, stopped a transaction, contacted the respondent or took other action for suspected fraud that turned out not to be fraud
coding_units: Count band: Never; One time; Two or three times; More than three times

meaning: Used the primary institution's mobile banking application on a smartphone or tablet in the past month
Used the primary institution's online banking on a laptop or desktop computer in the past month
Currently uses the institution's online customer-service chat with automated real-time responses
Currently uses a person-to-person (P2P) payment service through the institution, such as Zelle
Currently receives fraud, low-balance, overdraft-fee or large-charge alerts from the institution
How often the respondent uses a laptop, desktop or personal computer
role: Feature (RQ4), coded very frequently vs. less

meaning: How often the respondent uses a smartphone or mobile phone
role: Feature (RQ4), coded very frequently vs. less

meaning: Type of primary financial institution
coding_units: Credit union; Bank; Online-only bank; I'm not sure

meaning: Primary account is held at one of the 10 largest U.S. banks (CFPB recode)
A debit card was the product involved in the most recent fraud (victims only)
Other product involved: P2P service, wire transfer, personal check, cashier's check or money order, cash withdrawal, loan, other (victims only)
role: Descriptive; collapsed into the reference group of DEBIT_INVOLVED

meaning: Type of fraud or scam, e.g., trusted-person exploitation, imposter, phishing, investment, prize, online shopping (victims only)
role: SCAM_3 is focal IV as PHISHING (RQ2); others descriptive

meaning: Reported the most recent fraud to the primary bank or credit union (victims only)
role: Descriptive only; follows the outcome in time

meaning: The institution identified the fraud or scam and told the respondent about it (victims only)
The institution returned the money, or helped recover some or all of it (victims only)
role: Excluded from models because they are consequences of a loss; descriptive only

meaning: The institution's response made the respondent feel to blame (asked only if FRAUD4_1 is yes)
Agreement that the primary bank or credit union is trustworthy
coding_units: 5-point agreement: Strongly agree to Strongly disagree
role: Source of TRUST_HIGH; supporting analysis under RQ3

meaning: Agreement that the institution attempts to give a fair resolution when there is a problem
coding_units: 5-point agreement: Strongly agree to Strongly disagree

meaning: Age group of the respondent
role: Control (RQ1 to RQ3); feature (RQ4); fairness audit

meaning: Sex of the respondent
role: Control (RQ1 to RQ3); feature (RQ4); fairness audit

meaning: Combined race and ethnicity
role: Control (RQ1 to RQ3); feature (RQ4); fairness audit

meaning: Highest level of education
Annual household income
coding_units: U.S. dollars, banded: under 30,000; 30,000 to under 60,000; 60,000 to under 100,000; 100,000 or more

meaning: Urbanicity of residence
Experienced fraud or a scam at least once in the past year
coding_units: 1 = one time or more; 0 = never; not sure and skipped set to missing

meaning: Money was taken from the account in the most recent fraud, whether or not later recovered
coding_units: 1 = any money lost; 0 = no money taken; don't know and skipped set to missing

meaning: Money was lost and not fully recovered
coding_units: 1 = some or none recovered; 0 = all recovered or no money taken

meaning: Experienced at least one false-positive fraud intervention in the past year
coding_units: 1 = one time or more; 0 = never; skipped set to missing

meaning: Indicator versions of MOBILE, WEB, ACC2_6, ACC2_5 and ALERT_1
coding_units: 1 = yes; 0 = no; special responses set to missing

meaning: Primary institution is a credit union
coding_units: 1 = credit union; 0 = bank or online-only bank

meaning: Indicator versions of FRAUD3_1, FRAUD5_1 and SCAM_3
coding_units: 1 = yes; 0 = no; defined for fraud victims only

meaning: Experienced fraud two or more times in the past year
coding_units: 1 = two or more times; 0 = one time; defined for fraud victims only

meaning: Collapsed race/ethnicity (White NH, Black NH, Hispanic, Other NH) and education (HS or less, Some college, Bachelor, Postgraduate)
Strongly agrees that the institution is trustworthy
coding_units: 1 = strongly agree; 0 = any other valid answer

meaning: Risk band assigned from the RQ4 model's predicted probability of fraud experience
coding_units: Lower; Moderate; Higher (cut points fixed on training data)
role: Output of RQ4; input to the decision framework
